platformBaselines.mechanism: Selected by baselineName() in e2e/matches-management-visual.spec.ts, not by Playwright auto-suffixing: playwright.config.ts keeps snapshotPathTemplate '{testDir}/{testFileName}-snapshots/{arg}{ext}' (no platform token). When process.platform is linux and <frame>-light-linux.png exists, the frame compares against it; otherwise (darwin, or any frame without a -linux file) it compares against <frame>-light.png. A -linux file is a Chromium-on-Linux raster of the same live frame, never a design reference: the design reference hash stays in exportSha256.
platformBaselines.note: These five frames rasterize long text runs differently on Linux (glyph baseline rounding, FreeType vs CoreText) beyond their per-frame budgets, so CI carries its own baselines instead of widening the budgets (ledger F51). Regenerate a -linux file only on Linux CI/container output; darwin runs never touch them.
platformBaselines.maintenanceRule: Any layout, copy or style change that moves pixels in one of these five frames (or its edit/detail page) makes the -linux baseline stale: mac gates stay green while Linux CI fails. After such a change, push, take the fresh <frame>-light-linux-actual.png from the failed CI run's e2e-evidence artifact (stable across retries) and replace the file. Frame-region geometry is unaffected unless the pinned rects themselves move (t0SZec: saveAction is a documented finding pinned at the viewport bottom).
